title: Separate utilization peer roster capture from sampler volume-path capture
outcome: The one-second peer refresh tick captures only the peer roster and host role/identity, avoiding discarded project and test-worktree path cloning under StateInner.
acceptance: The refresh-loop roster path does not enumerate or clone configured project/test-run volume paths.
The five-second sampler retains bounded capture of all required path inputs and explicit overflow metadata.
Existing roster, cache, concurrency and sampling behavior remains covered by focused validation and independent review.
